submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE, 0.0651% at Sb 0.21. The measured EQE rose from Sb 0.12 (0.053%) to Sb 0.21 and fell by Sb 0.25 (0.046%). It was about zero at Sb 0.49 and Sb 0.75. XRD at Sb 0.12, 0.21 and 0.33 shows the same pattern at each point, with the strongest peak at Q≈1.88 and no clear sign of a separate hematite phase. This pattern was not checked against simulated patterns, so the phase is not confirmed. The response looks like a narrow optimum on the Fe-rich side, around Sb 0.2.
